Arne, Baran and Citronimus left Blackbridge at dawn and followed the old northern road toward Stonecross. Gunther had asked them to investigate reports of strange lights near the abandoned bell tower outside the settlement.

At Stonecross they met Mara Venn, the keeper of the Fox and Lantern Inn. Mara is an old acquaintance of Gunther and occasionally passes information to the Pale Wardens. She told the adventurers that several travellers had disappeared along the northern road during the last week.

Mara introduced them to Hadrik Sol, captain of the Stonecross Watch. Hadrik is responsible for the settlement's militia and patrols. He distrusts outsiders but agreed to cooperate after Mara vouched for the group.

Hadrik reported that his scouts had discovered tracks leading from the road toward the Old Bell Tower, an abandoned watchtower northwest of Stonecross.

One of the missing travellers had been carrying a small relic known as the Blackglass Key. According to Hadrik, the key once belonged to the Order of the Silver Lantern, an old fellowship that guarded the roads north of Stonecross.

Later that evening, Mara warned Baran that Seren Holt, a travelling merchant currently staying at the Fox and Lantern Inn, had been asking unusual questions about the Blackglass Key. Mara did not know whether Seren was simply curious or involved in the disappearances.

Arne, Baran and Citronimus decided to investigate the Old Bell Tower at first light. Gunther remained in Blackbridge but asked them to send word if they discovered any connection between the missing travellers and the Blackglass Key.
